span_text: The CardioPatch X1 is classified as a Class IIb non-invasive active medical device under MDR rule 10. The product is supplied sterile-free, single-patient use, and communicates with a validated reader application.
expected_matched_fragment: Class IIb non-invasive active medical device
root_cause: CLASS_IIA pattern requires exactly one \w+ token between class label and 'medical device'; 'non-invasive active' is two tokens (hyphenated first token breaks \w+ match after 'non')

Span contains no 'medical device' phrase at all; CLASS_IIA/CLASS_III/CLASS_I all require the phrase 'medical device'. Requires a separate bare-label pattern (e.g. 'Class IIb' in a table cell or parenthetical context) which is not in scope for the CLASS_IIA fix.
proposed_pattern: Separate pattern not yet specified; out of scope for RC-1 fix. Document as known gap.
notes: Dogfood report attributed this span to doc_921318243dfcba8b (GSPR); live ingestion places it in doc_2ec6b7b9fdadb3d4 (CER). The GSPR document has no Class IIb text at the span level. Dogfood report IDs were incorrect for this span.

span_text: This synthetic document is inspired by SSCP structure but CardioPatch X1 is modelled as a Class IIb non-implantable device. It is included only to test cross-document consistency and public-facing claim control.
root_cause: Span uses 'non-implantable device' rather than 'non-implantable medical device'. All three CLASS_* patterns require the word 'medical' before 'device'. The RC-1 fix (relaxing multi-adjective count) does not resolve this span unless 'medical' is also made optional.
proposed_pattern: Optional 'medical': re.compile(r"Class\s+II[ab]?\s+(?:[\w-]+\s+)*(?:medical\s+)?device", re.IGNORECASE) — requires separate review for false positive risk
notes: Dogfood report cited this as '...CardioPatch X1 is modelled as a Class IIb ...' with trailing ellipsis, implying 'medical device' was expected. Live text is 'Class IIb non-implantable device' — the word 'medical' is absent. This is a distinct sub-failure from span_1 and requires a wider pattern change with additional false-positive review.
